title: Mark G Probable NDE 22617
content: I came down with the flu, which turned into pneumonia. We were visiting my wife's brother's house at the time. I went to the hospital the previous day where they took an X-ray that showed pneumonia. I forget the name of the antibiotic, but I started taking it. The next day, my coughing was very bad. I was coughing up blood and feeling like I couldn't breathe right. I was leaning over the sink coughing up this blood and I remember praying for help when, the next thing I knew, I saw what could only be described as a shadowy hand in my mind. I had to make a choice. I was told that I could continue and that we have three times in life to make the choice, but that for me, my health would be worse in the future. I was desperate and I had two small boys at the time. I remember taking the hand and grabbing it and putting it right on my back where the pneumonia had shown on the X-ray. Immediately I stopped coughing. The next day, we were coming home to Virginia and I was having what looked like an allergic reaction to the antibiotic. We stopped at the hospital and the doctor looked at me and said it did look like a reaction. He asked why I was prescribed it and I told him pneumonia. He asked if I had the X-rays and I told I'm that it was done in a hospital in Maryland. He ordered another which showed absolutely no sign of pneumonia.

elements.At the time of your experience, was ther: Yes Illness, trauma or other condition not considered life threatening. I was suffering from pneumonia and was coughing up blood.
elements.At what time during the experience were: Not very conscious and I feel like parts of it are submerged, I clearly remember the big hand and putting it on my back where I believe the blood was coming from when I coughed.
elements.Did time seem to speed up or slow down?: Everything seemed to be happening at once; or time stopped or lost all meaning While the discussion of choices was occurring, I felt like that took a long time, but I don't really remember much of it.
elements.Did scenes from your past come back to y: My past flashed before me, out of my control
elements.Did you come to a border or point of no: I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will I wasn't really outside of my body per se, but it was weird.
elements.God, Spiritual and Religion: point of no return? I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will I wasn't really outside of my body per se, but it was weird. God, Spiritual and Religion
elements.Did you have a change in your values and: Yes I have almost become obsessed with getting back there. I had another experience when I was younger that I consciously had done, and now it seems as if I'm obsessed with near death and out of body experiences. Mostly just reading about them. I have come to believe that reality is much different than we believe but I am trying to prove it and am getting frustrated by it.
elements.Concerning our Earthly lives other than: ings Concerning our Earthly lives other than Religion: After the NDE
elements.After the NDE: included: Presence of unearthly beings Concerning our Earthly lives other than Religion: After the NDE
elements.Are there one or several parts of your e: Best part was no more coughing up blood. Worst part is that I have even more health issues than I did.
elements.Have you ever shared this experience wit: Yes Once, but they were ok with it. No judgment.
elements.At any time in your life, has anything e: Yes When I was younger I had a similar event that I will post in a follow up post.
elements.Is there anything else that you would li: It was my second experience with something weird. I will make a separate post regarding that. Before my Father died in 2007, he told me that he had an experience where he had died in an operating table (he had had an accident at the saw mill that had cut through an artery). He had gone somewhere and saw a group of people who were familiar somehow but didn't know them and was told he had to go back. He never knew about what had happened with me, and was telling me this because my mother had just died and he wanted to assure me that we go on.
